factive_support_semantics.definition: Supp(P, W_factive) = { eval(P, w) | w in W_factive and P defined in w }

TRUE.description: Invariant true across all admissible realities.

FALSE.description: Invariant false across all admissible realities.

CONTRADICTION.description: Mutually unsatisfiable premise constraints; fail-closed abort.

compound_propositions.rule: Compound expressions E = f(P_1, ..., P_k) evaluate using Supp(E, W_factive). E may be TRUE or FALSE while operands remain UNRESOLVED if Supp(E) is a singleton.

policy_separation.rule: Policy decisions (e.g. unwrap_or fallback) must be recorded in result.policy_decision, strictly separated from result.factive_truth.
